description: This file implements a server handling WebSocket and HTTP connections with SSL support, including connection management, request handling, SSL certificate loading, and server startup logic using Boost.Asio and Boost.Beast libraries.

classes.name: ConnectionHandler
classes.description: Manages active client connections for WebSocket and HTTP sessions, allowing adding and removing clients, and tracking connection info.

classes.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer
classes.description: Implements a server supporting WebSocket and HTTP protocols with SSL, managing connections, request processing, and server lifecycle.

classes.name: DetectSession
classes.description: Detects whether an incoming TCP connection uses SSL or not and launches appropriate session.

classes.name: BeastListener
classes.description: Listens for incoming TCP connections and initiates detection of SSL or plain HTTP sessions.

classes.name: HttpSession
classes.description: Base class template for handling HTTP sessions, supporting pipelining and WebSocket upgrade detection.

classes.name: SslHttpSession
classes.description: Handles SSL HTTP connections, including SSL handshake and shutdown.

classes.name: PlainWebsocketSession
classes.description: Handles WebSocket sessions over plain TCP.

classes.name: WebSocketSession
classes.description: Template class providing WebSocket session management, including accept, read, write, ping, and timeout handling.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes server with host, port, certificate path, and SSL settings, loads certificates, and sets up listener.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::HandleRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming JSON requests and dispatches to registered command processors based on connection type.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::AddListener
methods.description: Registers a new command processor listener for specific observer types.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::RemoveListener
methods.description: Removes a registered command processor listener.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::LoadCertData
methods.description: Loads SSL certificate and key files from specified path into SSL context.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::SendToConnection
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific connection identified by ConnectionId if it exists.

methods.name: WebSockHttpFlexServer::Start
methods.description: Starts the server, begins listening for connections, and runs I/O threads.
